versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected in this release.
- Content, behavior, and features remain the same as the previous version.
- Documentation, application rules, style tokens, and evaluation criteria are unchanged.

- Removed non-essential documentation files (README.md, skill-card.md, skill.json) for a lighter package.
- SKILL.md streamlined and rewritten for clarity, focusing on practical application and signature elements of Dante's literary style.
- Added direct links to live demo and try-before-install options.
- Concisely enumerated style tokens and anti-tokens with emphasis on core literary features.
- Reformulated application guidelines for writing, UI design, branding, and conversation to be more actionable and accessible to everyone.
Initial release: 10 style tokens, 5 anti-tokens, 3 signature passages with original Italian, application rules — distilled from 38 works including the complete Divine Comedy
